summary: Full backend + frontend test of the refactored Formalities mode (sovereign pipeline EEZ -> Ports of Entry). 20/20 backend pytest tests pass (referential listing, 18MB EEZ geojson, ports GeoJSON + mrgid filter, export, task status endpoints, legacy endpoints removed, stats, and a real end-to-end unitary generation on Fiji with 409-conflict check). Frontend verified end-to-end in Formalities mode: panel with 285 EEZ, disclaimer, search, status filter, 285 rows, 285 EEZ polygons on the map, amber PoE clusters, flyTo + Leaflet popup with status badge / PoE count / sources / generate button, EN-FR i18n, Audit card with the 4 PoE controls, and mode switching regression (projects/marinas/formalities) with zero console errors. One HIGH-severity data-loss bug found in the regeneration path (existing ports are deleted even when the new extraction returns 0 ports) plus a popup generate-button state bug.

critical.issue: DATA LOSS on regeneration: db.poe_ports.delete_many({mrgid}) runs unconditionally before checking the new extraction result. Reproduced live on Albania (mrgid=5670): zone was status='ia' with 4 PoE; a regenerate run selected different (non-authoritative) gov.al pages, the LLM extracted 0 ports, the 4 existing ports were deleted and the zone flipped to status='erreur', poe_count=0 (global total_ports dropped 35 -> 31). A second run restored it to ia/6 PoE. Fix: only delete+replace when docs is non-empty; otherwise keep previous ports and record last_error (or write to a temp set and swap atomically).

minor.issue: Non-deterministic pipeline: consecutive force runs on the same EEZ give different source sets and counts (Albania 4 -> 0 -> 6 PoE; Fiji 7 -> 6 PoE). Search/gatekeeper picks unrelated gov PDFs (e.g. arsimi.gov.al education budget PDF for Albania). Consider ranking/pinning previously successful source URLs.

Ports failing the spatial validation are still persisted and rendered (Albania 'Moli i Qytetit' geocoded 130 km inland, validated=false). Consider dropping non-validated far-inland points or flagging them distinctly in the GeoJSON/UI.

2 zones (Abu musa Greater and Lesser Tunb, Alhucemas Islands) sit in status='erreur' from a previous run and show a red ERROR badge in the sidebar with no explanatory tooltip; pre-existing, informational.

ui_bugs.issue: Generate/Regenerate progress state is lost: after clicking, the button shows '↻ Generating…' for ~6s then reverts to '↻ Regenerate' (enabled) while the pipeline is still running, and the final '✓ Generated' / '↻ Failed' label never appears. Root cause: the popup HTML is rebuilt when zones/ports are refetched, so the DOM node captured by document.querySelector('[data-testid=poe-generate-btn]') becomes stale (imperative DOM mutation instead of React state). Data does refresh (~40s later), but the user gets no reliable feedback and can re-trigger a run.

Clicking Fiji (mrgid=8325) flies to a view centred over Australia/PNG: the Fiji EEZ polygon and its PoE cluster sit at the extreme right edge of the map and the Leaflet popup opens partially outside the viewport (source URL text clipped). Antimeridian anchor handling should recentre on the anchor with autoPan for the popup.

issues: Popup 'EEZ: Marine Regions (VLIZ) v12 - CC-BY 4.0' attribution and the sidebar bottom attribution are very low contrast (dark grey on dark navy, ~8px) - hard to read
Zones in status 'erreur' show only a red ERROR badge without the last_error reason (only visible after opening the popup)

action_items: CRITICAL: poe.py:678 - do not delete existing poe_ports when the new extraction yields 0 ports; preserve previous data and set last_error instead of wiping the zone to status='erreur'/poe_count=0
HIGH: rework the popup generation feedback with React state (or re-query the button on every poll tick) so 'Generating…' persists and 'Generated'/'Failed' is shown after the run
MEDIUM: fix flyToZone for antimeridian EEZs (Fiji/Russia) so the zone is centred and the popup stays inside the viewport
LOW: filter or visually flag PoE that fail spatial validation (>100 km inland)
LOW: improve contrast of the attribution footers in the popup and sidebar
critical_code_review_comments: poe.py generate_zone_poe(): delete_many + insert_many is not atomic and is executed even for an empty extraction -> destructive regression on every failed regeneration. Guard with `if docs:` and keep the previous status/poe_count on failure.

App.js __biGeneratePoeZone(): imperative DOM manipulation of a Leaflet popup button is fragile (stale node after popup re-render). Prefer a React-rendered popup (portal) or resolve the node inside the polling loop.

poe_routes.py: GEN_TASKS / REF_STATE / BATCH_STATE are in-process module globals - status is lost on backend reload and inconsistent with multiple workers; acceptable for the preview but worth noting.
MapView.js is 858 lines and server.py 1776 lines - both above the 700-line guideline, consider splitting (EEZ layer / cluster layer / popup builders).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Existing data preserved: 285 EEZ, 4 generated zones (Alaska 13, Albania 6, Fiji 6, Algeria ia_sans_source), 37 ports. NOTE: Fiji regenerated to 6 PoE (was 7) and Albania to 6 PoE (was 4) as a side effect of the real generation tests; Albania was wiped by the bug above and restored with /app/backend/tests/restore_albania.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_poe_api.py` (fast, 19 tests) for regression; `test_poe_generate.py` performs a real Gemini+Nominatim run on Fiji (~40s) and asserts the 409 conflict. Do NOT trigger the referential build or the PoE batch. Known open items: (1) destructive delete of poe_ports on failed regeneration (poe.py:678) - re-verify by regenerating an already-generated zone twice and checking summary.total_ports never decreases; (2) popup generate button state reverting to 'Regenerate' mid-run; (3) Fiji flyTo/popup off-viewport. EEZ geojson is 18MB - allow ~10-16s after switching to Formalities mode before asserting on map layers.
rca_of_the_issue: poe.generate_zone_poe() unconditionally executes `await db.poe_ports.delete_many({'mrgid': mrgid})` (line 678) before evaluating the freshly extracted `docs`. Because the source-discovery + LLM extraction stage is non-deterministic (SearXNG/grounding can return unrelated official PDFs), a regeneration that extracts 0 ports permanently destroys the previously validated ports and demotes the zone to status='erreur', poe_count=0. Reproduced live on Albania (35 -> 31 ports); restored by a second generation run (6 ports).
